title: A telescoping verification of a focal-inversion area invariant

native.title: A telescoping verification of a focal-inversion area invariant

actual: Read complete hash-bound TeX and exact seven-page searchable PDF, with direct visual checks of the first page, local identity and repeated-list calculations. Separate adversaries inspected all native PDF pages as pixels.
proof: For a proper nested confocal elliptic pair with least collision period divisible by four, signed original orbit area times signed area of the straight-edge vertex inversion about either focus is a positive phase-invariant constant. Stars, reversal, choice of focus and repetition scaling r² are covered.

The square-root focal distances in canonical coordinates are positive, and the exact rational local Jacobi identity applies over the whole strict domain, with no division by the potentially zero V parameter. Antipodal pairing converts to the m=N/2 grid. Cyclic shifts eliminate the derivative differences, leaving translated dn traces. The half-grid Landen product fixes the explicit constant; V=0 correctly gives the ordinary period-four value 4.

There is an exact real connected triangular family with a proper confocal pair. The two triples have different original/inversion product; repeated four times, these twelve-entry lists differ by −20√6/9. This is strictly a list-length failure and does not contradict the least-period theorem.
